findings.title: Appendix A prose and 6.1/O6/O7 describe a script that the code block does not match (30/300/30 ms with a discarded warm-up, versus 20/200/40 ms with none)
findings.evidence: Audit lines 588-592 and 6.1 say 30 connections, 300 echoes 30 ms apart, one discarded warm-up connection. The appendix code has i<20, sleep(300), i<200, sleep(40), and no warm-up connect. O6 says the script discards one warm-up connection. O7 says 200 keystrokes, contradicting 6.2's 300.
findings.consequence: The owner is told the first sample is free of the slow first-connection artefact when it is not. With n=20 the p95 equals the max, so CMD and PowerShell O6 results carry the artefact and are misread as shell start-up cost. The headline figures are not reproducible from the script as shown. The first judgement's appendix-parameters point is unresolved.
findings.minimal_fix: Make the script match the prose (one discarded warm-up connect, 30 connections, 300 echoes, sleep(30)), or correct the appendix prose, 6.1, O6 and O7 to 20/200/40 ms with no warm-up and report median only.
